service.ur: سرکاری اسکول میں رجسٹریشن اور داخلہ

about: Register a child in a UAE public school from kindergarten to Grade 12.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Public school registration and admission. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to categories such as citizens, children of female citizens, GCC nationals, children of diplomats and decree holders
New students enter at kindergarten or Grade 1, others transfer in from private or foreign schools
documents: Proof of residence (electricity bill, notarised lease or ownership document)
Report card for the current year for Grades 2 to 12
Birth certificate for children of female citizens
Diplomatic card, decree copy or GCC certification depending on the category
Medical or psychological report under 6 months old for students of determination
timing: Initial advanced-track approval in 3 working days, final approval 7 working days after the test
channels: MOE website or mobile app, sign in with UAE PASS
